title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Free exhibitions, lectures, symposia, creative sessions, and campus-to-city outings documented by Lewis & Clark College. Check linked schedules before attending seasonal programs.

cards.entity_name: Ronna and Eric Hoffman Gallery of Contemporary Art
cards.title: Browse the Hoffman Gallery Together
cards.subtitle: A free contemporary-art stop beside Fields Center
cards.notes: Meet at the gallery plaza, browse the current exhibition together, and leave time to compare one work each before closing.
cards.short_summary: Share an unhurried look at the gallery’s current student or contemporary-art exhibition.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis & Clark states that the Hoffman Gallery is free and open to the public and lists daily hours of 11 a.m.–4 p.m.
cards.source_title: Ronna and Eric Hoffman Gallery of Contemporary Art
cards.access_notes: Open to the public without admission; the official page currently lists daily hours of 11 a.m.–4 p.m. Confirm the exhibition calendar before visiting.

cards.title: Make Art at an Open Studio
cards.subtitle: A no-cost creative gathering on the graduate campus
cards.notes: Check the program schedule, bring a friend to an open-studio session, and use the shared creative time for low-pressure artmaking.
cards.short_summary: Spend a weekly session creating alongside community members in an open studio.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lewis & Clark Art Therapy Program states that all of its weekly studio sessions are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and public, with in-person and virtual formats described by the program. Consult the linked program information for the next session and location.

cards.title: Choose a Symposium Session
cards.subtitle: Three days of panels, films, workshops, and performances
cards.notes: Scan the annual program with friends, choose one session that sparks discussion, and meet afterward to trade reactions and questions.
cards.short_summary: Turn a free public panel, screening, or performance into a thoughtful group outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis & Clark documents the annual Gender Studies Symposium and states that its events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The symposium is seasonal. Events are free and public, but attendees should consult the current program for dates, venues, and any session-specific instructions.

cards.entity_name: Middle East and North African Studies Symposium
cards.title: Catch a MENA Symposium Event
cards.subtitle: Student-organized films, talks, art, and performances
cards.notes: Pick a film, lecture, or performance from the published schedule and invite classmates to continue the conversation after the session.
cards.short_summary: Gather around a student-curated program focused on Middle Eastern and North African cultures.
cards.evidence_claim: The college says the Middle East and North African Studies Symposium presents panels, screenings, performances, and other events that are free and public.
cards.source_title: About • Middle East and North African Studies Symposium
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public during the annual symposium. Check the current symposium schedule for dates, locations, and accessibility details.

cards.entity_name: Ray Warren Symposium on Race and Ethnic Studies
cards.title: Join a Ray Warren Session
cards.subtitle: Public workshops, panels, lectures, and performances
cards.notes: Choose a session from the event schedule, arrive with a discussion partner, and review the organizers’ participation guidance beforehand.
cards.short_summary: Attend a student-organized public program centered on race and ethnic studies.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis & Clark states that Ray Warren Symposium lectures, panels, performances, and workshops are free and open to the public unless noted otherwise.
cards.source_title: Event Details • Ray Warren Symposium on Race and Ethnic Studies
cards.access_notes: Most sessions are free and public; verify the live schedule because organizers may mark exceptions or request registration for individual events.

cards.title: Hear an Artist Explain Their Work
cards.subtitle: Free evening talks hosted by the Art Department
cards.notes: Read the featured artist’s short biography, attend the lecture with a friend, and compare notes on one idea that changed how you see their work.
cards.short_summary: Share an evening listening to a practicing artist discuss process, theory, and recent projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Department states that all Visiting Artist Program lectures are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and public. Use the official page to confirm the current speaker, date, and room; the listed series information places lectures in Miller 105.

cards.title: Spend an Hour at the International Symposium
cards.subtitle: Public panels, workshops, fashion, and art programming
cards.notes: Coordinate around one public session, arrive early enough to find the venue, and stay afterward to discuss the program’s central question.
cards.short_summary: Meet around a globally focused panel, workshop, performance, or exhibit.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis & Clark’s International Students and Scholars events page describes a three-day symposium and says events are free and public unless noted on the schedule.
cards.access_notes: The symposium is seasonal. Review the current schedule because the college explicitly allows individual events to be marked as exceptions.

cards.title: Talk Climate Ideas at ENVX
cards.subtitle: An environmental symposium built around public discussion
cards.notes: Watch for the next ENVX program, select a keynote or panel with friends, and each bring one question for the post-session conversation.
cards.short_summary: Use a free environmental talk or panel as the starting point for a group discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis & Clark documented its 27th annual ENVX Symposium as featuring keynotes, a screening, a panel, and a reception, with all events free and public.
cards.source_title: 27th Annual Environmental Studies Symposium Focuses on Green Innovation in China and the U.S.
cards.access_notes: This source documents the recurring symposium’s 2024 edition. Wait for the next official ENVX schedule and confirm that its sessions retain free admission.

cards.title: Take a Free Campus-to-City Ride
cards.subtitle: An L&C community shuttle outing to downtown Portland
cards.notes: Check the live timetable, board with your L&C ID, ride downtown with friends, and return on a scheduled trip without building the hang around a purchase.
cards.short_summary: Make the complimentary shuttle ride itself a social campus-to-downtown change of scenery.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis & Clark describes OtterBus as a free shuttle for students, staff, and faculty connecting campus, downtown, and public transportation.
cards.access_notes: Limited to Lewis & Clark students, staff, and faculty. It does not run during summer session; check the current timetable and service notices before leaving.

cards.title: Explore the EAR Forest
cards.subtitle: An outdoor sound-and-arts laboratory beside Fields Center
cards.notes: Walk into the outdoor laboratory with a friend, listen closely to the site’s instruments or installations, and compare what each of you notices.
cards.short_summary: Share a playful listening session in Lewis & Clark’s forest-based experimental arts space.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis & Clark’s alumni schedule identifies the EAR Forest beside Fields Center as an outdoor laboratory and describes its play-the-instruments event as complimentary with no registration required.
cards.access_notes: The cited complimentary activity is event-dependent. Check the current Homecoming or Arts schedule before using instruments or entering programmed areas.

warnings: ENVX and several symposium cards are seasonal; their linked official pages document free admission, but attendees should verify the next program dates.
OtterBus is restricted to Lewis & Clark students, staff, and faculty and does not operate during summer session.
EAR Forest instrument access depends on scheduled programming; confirm the current event before participating.
